answer_1.quote: Experiments on commonly used datasets demonstrate that our method achieves significant improvements on open-domain question-answering tasks.

answer_2.quote: we evaluate performance on the PopQA and TriviaQA datasets using factual accuracy... we employ ASQA and utilize 948 queries in dev set for evaluation. We adopt the official metrics of str-em, Rouge-L (Chin-Yew, 2004) (R-L), QA-Hit, QA-EM, and QA-F1 scores.
